53287659241585;Leather gloves worn by Balthazar, the Wyvernflame. The blood-red leather across the knuckles glints with a vivid hue amidst the dancing flames. They are tempered to withstand both searing heat and the concussive force of a blast.

54550379626609;An ornate bow used by a self-proclaimed "Masked Liberators." Flashy in appearance and formidable in performance, it draws smoothly and maintains its power even in sandstorms. Contrary to their talk of salvation, in practice it's used to raid villages and butcher people.

56693568307313;A mace wielded by the earthen soldiers of Hexe Sanctuary. When the jar shatters, the sound is like a scream. Perhaps it is the wailing of tormented souls, fleeing at last to freedom.

56697863274609;A heavy club engraved with an ornate pattern. Its exquisite balance makes it remarkably easy to wield. It is said that a blacksmith with no knowledge of engineering poured his passion into this weapon to prove his service to Marni.

56702158241905;A mace once held by the Marquis of Calphade on the border front. Its blackened head and red cloth embody the resolve of House Lanford, known as the Unyielding Shields. Every swing lands with a heavy ring, like a vow to never fall back.

57127360004209;A musket that embodies the engineering of Marni, the genius engineer. It is the pinnacle of technology, operating with precisely enhanced parts. It is said to be the result of researching existing firearms and crafting them while conceptualizing a gun capable of reloading and shooting automatically.

57140244906097;A masterwork musket that was bestowed upon the hero who saved Demeniss. Precisely crafted with the finest skills, it boasts overwhelming performance. The Demeniss of today was not built in a day, and this weapon is a treasure symbolizing the kingdom's numerous victories. Its value is beyond measure.

57982058496113;A rapier used in the coronation ceremonies of the Thorel royalty. Once a symbol of Demeniss's prosperity and royal legitimacy, it is now a faded relic that serves only as a reminder of past glory.

58411555225713;A shield used by the earthen soldiers of Hexe Sanctuary. The sorcery that uses brimstone-filled jars was not invented by Hexe Marie, but she was the one who refined it for the most wicked and corrupt purposes.

58428735094897;A shield card in the likeness of a grey wolf. Its origins are unknown, but in Pywel, the wolf has long symbolized an unyielding will and the bond of the pack. Perhaps that is why this strange relic feels so familiar.

58433030062193;A shield designed in Delesyia using repurposed siege engine parts. Thick metal plates absorb and deflect impacts, and decorative motifs keep it from looking crude, giving it an elegant appearance.

59309203390577;The sword of a warrior who slew a legendary dragon. Its flashing edge seems capable of cutting through anything, and it boasts durability enough to endure a dragon's flames. 59313498357873;A pure white blade radiating an eerie power. This weapon was forged using a refinement process unlike any other. Every swing seems to echo with the howl of a beast.

59317793325169;A sword made with the scales of Aeserion, the Great Serpent. The scales used for this weapon are imbued with a power not of this world. The stars prove that where the map ends, the true story begins.

It's not calculated safety but relentless progress down rugged roads that opens new horizons.

4298291600708801;Hammer Constellation discovered.

4298291600714945;Ship Constellation discovered.
Those stars drifting across the endless sea of the night sky symbolize a free spirit bound by nothing.
A journey that sets its sails to the winds of fate, with no fixed course, is all the greater for not knowing where it will end.

4298291600716993;Elephant Constellation discovered.

To receive another's devotion is an honor, yet it is also the loneliest path, one that demands the heaviest burden of responsibility.

4298291600719041;Camel Constellation discovered.
Those stars that shine stubbornly even in barren darkness represent a life force that refuses to fade, even where hope has run dry.
Even in a destiny as harsh as a desert, those who endure and keep walking will carve out a new path of their own.

4298291600721089;Goblin Constellation discovered.

The wisdom to read the world's currents is precious, but those consumed by endless greed for wealth can never escape a fate of dragging their burdens forever.

4298291600723137;Black Dragon Constellation discovered.
Those stars, quietly gleaming in the darkest sky, symbolize an overwhelming dominion that watches over the world from unseen heights.
True power is never loud. It governs all from the depths of stillness.

4298291600725185;Giant Constellation discovered.
The stars stretching wide across the sky resemble the eyes of a giant, filled with deep thought and grand ambition.
Only those who look beyond small gains and dare to dream bigger will be remembered, enduring like the stars themselves.

4298291600727233;Key Constellation discovered.

Once a key is turned, there is no undoing it. Only a decisive moment without regret can open the door to a new world.

4309106328338625;I lay down to sleep, but the face of that fellow Bernor I saw earlier suddenly came to mind, and I couldn't help picking up my pen. Even now, thinking about that unlucky fool sitting there with tears in his eyes makes me laugh.
4309110623305841;A loose page torn from someone's log. It's tattered, but the writing is still readable.

4309110623305921;What a petty little wretch! The fellow skulking in that shabby forge was showing off a dagger carved from a dragon's tooth, and I only humored him. When I nearly walked out with it—purely because I mistook it for my own—he had the gall to brand me a thief! The thought still makes my blood boil with indignation. I'll not forget that name. Renier.
4309114918273137;A loose page torn from someone's log. It's tattered, but the writing is still readable.

4309114918273217;I can scarcely believe it! Alvaris, the one who struts about like a fancy lord, was a notorious pick-pocket in his youth. And now they bow to him, thanking him for his service to the region. Unbelievable, the hypocrite. How did he pull it off? Did he butter up the higher-ups with stolen treasure, or dig up some filthy secret and blackmail them? One day, I too, shall...
4309119213240433;A loose page torn from someone's log. It's tattered, but the writing is still readable.

4309119213240513;Speckles hasn't walked properly for days. I thought he was simply starving since none of us has eaten well lately. As I sweated over the poor beast lying there, a man with a lustrous beard appeared from nowhere. He thrust an arm into Speckles's mouth, rummaged around, and drew out a thorn-wood splinter the length of a finger! The stranger, Faisal, said he keeps a small stable in Varnia. I've never felt such gratitude in my life. O savior of Speckles—my noble benefactor!
4309123508207729;A loose page torn from someone's log. It's tattered, but the writing is still readable.

4309123508207809;That man Olanelle is unbearably vain. Every sentence is about trends and refinement, like he's some noble. I went to pick up my repaired cloak, and I saw that he'd stitched a gaudy pattern in red along the hem. Says it's the latest fashion. Who would wear that? A jester? When I complained, he gave me a look like I was an idiot. He's the pathetic one here!
4309127803175025;A loose page torn from someone's log. It's tattered, but the writing is still readable.

4309127803175105;I now know very clear that every last northerner is petty. Even Richart was no different, and he's supposed to be one of the finest bloke in Beighen. I tumbled while hunting centipedes at his request and hurt myself, yet he flatly refused any compensation. So I slipped a few coins into my pocket, hoping at least to top up my paltry pay, and the whole village's strapping lads charged out after me. Miserable lot. I'm certain one of them was waving an axe. I doubt I'll find easy sleep tonight.
4309132098142321;A loose page torn from someone's log. It's tattered, but the writing is still readable.

4309132098142401;I spent the entire night drinking with a man named Nolfex. At first, I only meant to humor him and maybe walk away with a bundle of silk. But in the end, his story struck me right in the heart. The scar still visible on his ankle and the burn mark on his forearm are hard to forget. When he spoke about fleeing with the camel he had shared both hardship and joy with, only to lose his way in the desert, my eyes stung with tears. Last night will stay with me for a long time.
4309136393109617;A loose page torn from someone's log. It's tattered, but the writing is still readable.

4309136393109697;Pururin? Pororin? Whatever it's called, this village is insane. Children who look no more than six or seven are running the place like elders. Strange leaves burn on every corner, smoke filling the air, while these children chatter in some secret tongue, laughing their heads off. A kid named Lumiel claimed she's conducting "research" and shoved a vile-looking liquid at me and asked for my help with an experiment. Hah! As if I'd be fooled that easily.

Hold on, have my hands always had webbing between the fingers?

4309140688076993;I happened to spend a few days with a fellow named Stonefell. The more I watched him, the more impressive he seemed. Other than eating and sleeping, he's always reading or writing. 4309144983044209;A loose page torn from someone's log. It's tattered, but the writing is still readable.

4309144983044289;Today I made friends with a man by the splendid name of Caden. This cursed village is so lawless it's practically a refuge for outlaws. 4309149278011585;I always thought a whip was meant for driving cattle or horses, until I met a woman who dropped five or six bandits with a single lash. 4309153572978801;A loose page torn from someone's log. It's tattered, but the writing is still readable.

4309153572978881;Nothing went right today. In barely half a day I stumbled into bandits twice, Speckles took an arrow in the rump, and my pack was swept off down the river. I had a bad feeling the moment I saw him draped in rags, clutching a shattered sword, muttering something about a bear ruining his homeland, though I didn't bother to listen. The fellow just can't keep his nose out of other people's troubles. If he hears of anyone snared by brigands, he flings himself into the fray until they're free. He must think he has nine lives, but I certainly don't. I'm leaving him behind before dawn breaks tomorrow.

4310618156826817;To you, who have arrived here following the will of Solumen.

All things have a predestined flow. Yet, places where his voice has not reached remain abandoned in chaos. The land is barren only because the people do not know the natural order of life. We shall go forth and spread his words. Soon, the people will realize their purpose and reap a bountiful harvest. However, to cast light further, one requires oil. Please contribute your sincerity to the donation box so that our priests may carry his words even further. Your generous support today will, by tomorrow morning, extend the reach of our journey. Do not wait for miracles. Instead, have faith in the honest providence of sowing a seed to see it sprout.

4310626746761409;Swordsmanship is not a matter of muscles, but the principle of filling and emptying the spiritual vessel. Run and swing the blade without rest, and your vessel will run dry as the body stiffens. Stopping an enemy's bloodlust also burns through one's energy. If you force yourself to endure with an empty vessel, you will eventually collapse, defenceless. One's energy recovers fastest standing in stillness. Be patient. Learn to refill the vessel in a momentary stop amidst the heat of battle.
4310631041728625;A letter from someone about Keen Senses.

4310631041728705;By the time you track the enemy's blade with your eyes, it is already too late. You must awaken your senses the very instant their bloodthirsty gaze falls on your skin. Do not cower in fear before the strike. Instead, remain calm and meet the blade just before it connects. This is more than mere defense, it shall become an iron wall that bounces off your foes. In moments of peril, take a bold step forward and swing. By striking at the enemy's opening, you can seize the momentum and turn the tide in a single moment. Do not focus on what is seen, but read the flow and trust your instincts. That intuition will lead you to a higher state of mastery.

4310635336696001;The messenger may be ragged, but the meaning carried within is anything but light.
Forgive me; it's to avoid prying eyes.

Powerful enemies lie in wait in Pywel, defying the natural order.
Facing that chaos may be too much for you now.

To set the broken balance right, you must first become its unshakable pillar.

Awaken your strength and claim a wider range of skills.
Clothe yourself in tempered steel and the power of magic.
That will become your fastest shield and your sharpest spear.

Remember this: the restoration of order begins at the tip of your blade.

-- Alustin

2804208156425585046;- Prime Pair
The strongest hand, made with a combination of Red 3 and 8.

- Superior Pair
A hand made with a combination of Red 1 & 3 or 1 & 8.
It's the strongest hand after Prime Pair.

- Ten Pair
A hand made with a combination of 10 & 10.
It can beat every hand except Prime or Superior Pair.

- Pair
A hand made with a pair of the same number.
The higher the number, the stronger the hand.

- One-two
A hand made with a combination of 1 & 2.
It's the strongest hand after Pair.

- One-four
A hand made with a combination of 1 & 4.
It's the strongest hand after One-two.

- One-nine
A hand made with a combination of 1 & 9.
It's the strongest hand after One-four.

- One-ten
A hand made with a combination of 1 & 10.
It's the strongest hand after One-nine.

- Four-ten
A hand made with a combination of 4 & 10.
It's the strongest hand after One-ten.

- Four-six
A hand made with a combination of 4 & 6.
It's the strongest hand after Four-ten.

- Perfect Nine
A hand where the last digit of the sum of the two cards is 9.
It's the strongest hand after Four-six.

- Points
A standard combination that doesn't match any of the hands above.
The higher the last digit of the sum of the two cards, the stronger the hand.

- Zero
A combination that doesn't match any of the hands above, where the last digit of the sum of the two numbers is 0.
It's the weakest hand.

A hand made up of two cards with the same number.
The higher the number, the stronger the hand.

A hand where the sum of the two card numbers ends with 9.
The second strongest hand after Four-six.

- Points
A regular combination that doesn't fall under the above rankings.
The higher the last digit of the sum of the two card numbers, the stronger the hand.

- Zero
A combination that doesn't fall under the above rankings, where the last digit of the sum of the two card numbers is 0.
The weakest hand except Bust.

- Bust
A state where the player failed to make 10, 20, or 30 with three cards.
If you are in Bust, you cannot use the remaining two cards even if they form a strong hand.

Pay the base ante while seated to start Five-Card.
You'll receive 5 cards and can check your hand. Out of these, you must combine 3 cards to make a total of 10, 20, or 30.

You can chose one of the next actions when your turn comes:

- Check: Pass the turn without raising the pot
- All in: Bet all your currently held silver
- Half Raise: Bet half of the total current pot
- Double Raise: Bet double the amount raised by the previous player
- Call: Match the amount raised by the previous player
- Fold: Forfeit the current round

Call is automatic if the 10 second time limit is exceeded. The cards are revealed when the pot can no longer be raised or when all players match the current bet. You can't keep playing if your silver falls below the base ante.
